name: Delete Party Relation { Id }
purpose: Deletes a PartyRelation by Id and also its reciprocal row (the same two parties in reverse order). Locks the relation through the DBTransactions selector, remembers the From/To party ids, deletes the first row of PartyRelationPortal through a helper script, then looks up the reciprocal row by the swapped party ids and deletes it the same way. Transaction pattern; Id required.
